matches.tactical_summary: Ivory Coast controlled possession and capitalized on individual brilliance and a defensive error for their goals, effectively managing the game. Curaçao showed moments of resilience but struggled to create clear-cut chances against a well-organized Ivorian defense.

narrative: Ivory Coast secured a historic qualification to the World Cup knockout stages for the first time, defeating debutants Curaçao 2-0 with a brace from Nicolas Pepe. This victory cemented their second-place finish in Group E, while Curaçao's inaugural World Cup journey concluded without a win.
